source.source: ICES Ocean Hydrochemistry: bottle and low-resolution CTD
source.citation: ICES Data Portal, Dataset on Ocean Hydrochemistry, extracted November 3, 2026. ICES, Copenhagen. CC BY 4.0.
source.method: Quality flag QV:ODV=0 only. Mean within each cast at 0–1 m, then day, then year-month, then equal weight across available years. Two main-channel station seasonal means weighted by inverse distance squared. No temporal filling. All grid values are spatial estimates, not measurements.
source.limitations: Historical seasonal reference, not 2025/2026 salinity. Two stations cannot resolve local shoreline, channel or island effects. A 100 m display grid does not mean 100 m source accuracy. Recent western observations are separate and include unknown quality (ODV=1). Practical salinity is dimensionless, not directly absolute salinity in g/kg.

limitations: Mixed years: satellite months 2025/2026; model and wind 2025; salinity 1989-2003.
Historical salinity is not combined into contemporary growth estimates.
Monthly residual current is not mean speed or a peak current.
Interpolation to 100 m does not increase native environmental resolution.
Missing values remain null; no temporal filling.
All local growth, oxygen, waves and settlement gates remain unresolved.
